fusions.name: Calcified Tread
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, 10% more for each affliction on it (up to 30%), and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Budding Colony
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 13 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Reef Lookout
fusions.desc: Grows a coral outcrop that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds, each strike with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
